title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Revised Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Implementing the Amended Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court

Fa [2023] No. 183

To: All High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; all Intellectual Property Courts; all Intermediate People's Courts with jurisdiction over technology-related intellectual property and monopoly cases:

In order to implement the Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Amending the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court, adopted at the 1901st meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on October 16, 2023, the following matters are hereby notified:

1. The "major and complex civil and administrative appeal cases concerning ownership and infringement of utility model patents, technical secrets, and computer software" as provided in paragraph 1, item 3 of Article 2 of the amended Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court refers to cases in which an appeal is filed against a judgment or ruling rendered by a High People's Court at first instance.

2. For cases in which a judgment or ruling is rendered after November 1, 2023, and which are not of the type specified in paragraph 1 of Article 2 of the amended Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court, the court of appeal shall be the people's court at the next higher level above the court of first instance. The court of first instance shall provide accurate guidance on this matter in the concluding part of the judgment or ruling.

3. For cases belonging to the type specified in paragraph 1 of Article 2 of the amended Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court, if the court of first instance issues a ruling on a preservative measure relating to conduct after November 1, 2023, the concluding part of the ruling shall state: "If you are not satisfied with this ruling, you may apply to this court or the Supreme People's Court for one reconsideration within five days from the date of receipt of the ruling. The implementation of the ruling shall not be suspended during the reconsideration period." Where a party submits an application for reconsideration to the Supreme People's Court through the court of original trial, the court of original trial shall, within five days, collate the relevant case files and transfer them to the Intellectual Property Court of the Supreme People's Court.

4. All High People's Courts shall diligently handle civil and administrative appeal cases concerning ownership and infringement of utility model patents, technical secrets, and computer software, as well as administrative appeal cases concerning design patents involving administrative rulings, etc. They shall promptly allocate specialized trial personnel to their intellectual property trial departments, and at the same time strengthen guidance and supervision of lower courts in the trial of relevant types of cases, to ensure uniformity of adjudication standards and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of trials.

Any problems encountered in the implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

This notice is hereby given.

October 21, 2023
